## Description:

This is a fisherman knit sweater designed for adult males, but will fit other average humans. The texture comes with a normal map, which is essential to make the sweater look more sweater-like. Five other colors are available in Materials. Illustration model, Hal, is also wearing Mindfront's M Trousers 01, which can be found here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/m\_trousers\_01.html
